```{r}
#| output: asis
#| label: tbl-reconciliation-summary
#| tbl-cap: !expr 'sR$`tbl-reconciliation-summary`$`tbl-cap`'
#| tbl-cap-location: top

# NEOIPC-PERMANENT(dataset-format): see rename_legacy_antibiotic_table() in
# the Partner Report's _setup.qmd. A dataset serialized before neoipcr
# 0.0.0.9007, or calculated from a raw dataset written before it, carries no
# reconciliation summary, and one imported with the reconciliations switched
# off carries an empty one; the section says which. Without the first branch
# such a file would be described as built with the reconciliations switched
# off, when it predates them.
reconciliation_strings <- sR$`tbl-reconciliation-summary`
reconciliation <- reference_data$reconciliationSummary
if (is.null(reconciliation)) {
  no_data_table(reconciliation_strings$not_recorded)
} else if (!has_reconciliation_summary(reconciliation)) {
  no_data_table(reconciliation_strings$not_reconciled)
} else {
  tbl <- format_reconciliation_summary_table(
    list(reconciliation), sR, font_size = summary_table_font_size)
  if (is.null(tbl))
    no_data_table(reconciliation_strings$no_reconciliations)
  else
    tbl
}
```
